About BITS Pilani

BITS Pilani is India's most respected private engineering university, known for its unique Practice School program, highly flexible curriculum, and extraordinary startup culture. The BITS alumni network includes founders of Flipkart, Snapdeal, OYO, and hundreds of global tech companies. Students routinely bag international pre-placement offers through PS-II at top companies worldwide.
